title: CAC Exam Practice Questions
source: Certified Associate Constructor (CAC) Official Study Guide practice test

questions.question: Which statement is true about using texting to communicate in construction?

options.A: A means of easily and effectively documenting communication
options.B: Appropriate for clarifying but not for formal direction
options.C: Should be completely avoided in construction
options.D: Acceptable for communication if specifically allowed in the contract

questions.explanation: Texting is fine for quick clarification, but it is too informal and poorly documented to issue formal direction or changes.

questions.question: Which of the following is the best example of an open-ended question?

options.A: Do you understand what work is supposed to be completed?
options.B: Do you know which shovel to get me from the tool shed?
options.C: What steps are you going to take to complete the activity?
options.D: How do you feel about completing the activities assigned?

questions.explanation: An open-ended question cannot be answered with a simple yes or no and makes the listener explain, which confirms real understanding.

questions.question: How would a 3-phase, 120/208V load most accurately be wired?

options.A: One hot, one neutral, and one ground conductor
options.B: Two hot and one neutral conductor
options.C: Three hot and one neutral conductor

questions.explanation: A 3-phase, 4-wire system uses three hot legs plus a shared neutral.

questions.question: Which fire protection system is most appropriate for an unconditioned (unheated) warehouse in Chicago storing paper, wood, and other Class A combustibles?
questions.explanation: In an unheated building in a cold climate, a wet pipe system could freeze and burst, so a dry pipe system is used.

questions.question: The owner wants to fast-track a project. Which delivery system best supports this?
questions.explanation: Design-build keeps design and construction under one entity, which lets the two phases overlap and supports fast-tracking.

questions.question: A project engineer is writing a purchase order for a steel package. Which law governs the basic rules of the sale of goods?
questions.explanation: The Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) governs the sale of goods such as a materials purchase order.

questions.question: A steel subcontractor retracts the bid the contractor relied on to win the job. What is the most appropriate legal argument for restitution?
questions.explanation: Promissory estoppel applies because the contractor reasonably relied on the sub’s promise (bid) to their detriment.

questions.question: Which graphical tool is a bar chart that displays a frequency distribution?
questions.explanation: A histogram is a bar chart showing how often values fall within ranges, which is a frequency distribution.

questions.question: Which is the most efficient temporary form system for concrete poured continually in the vertical direction?
questions.explanation: A slip form moves upward continuously as concrete is placed, which suits a continuous vertical pour.

questions.question: Which party is typically responsible for designing temporary structural formwork?
questions.explanation: Means and methods, including formwork design, are the contractor’s or vendor’s responsibility, not the designer’s.

questions.question: Which system is designed to carry the total vertical load of a structure?
questions.explanation: Piling transfers the full vertical load of the structure down to a competent bearing layer.

questions.question: Which party holds the design liability for a prescriptive specification?
questions.explanation: A prescriptive spec dictates the exact product and method, so the designer (architect/engineer) keeps the design liability.

questions.question: A contractor receives a notice of award but decides not to accept the contract. What is the likely outcome?

options.A: They lose the amount of their bond premium
options.B: They lose the amount of their bid bond face value
options.C: They can withdraw without ramifications as long as nothing is signed
options.D: They lose the amount of their performance bond face value

questions.explanation: Backing out after award forfeits the bid bond, which covers the owner’s cost to award to the next bidder.

questions.question: Which statement is true about the critical path?

options.A: It is the shortest string of activities through the schedule
options.B: It is the longest string of activities through the schedule
options.C: It has zero total float but possibly some free float in the activities
options.D: It includes all activities that cannot be compressed any further

questions.explanation: The critical path is the longest duration path through the network, and it sets the shortest possible project length.

questions.question: How is fast tracking defined in construction?

options.B: Overlapping execution of the construction activities
options.C: Finalizing the design and procurement before construction begins
options.D: Overlapping execution of the design, procurement, and construction

questions.explanation: Fast tracking overlaps design, procurement, and construction rather than running them in sequence.

questions.question: What is the term for shifting activities within their free float to smooth the workforce and reduce peak resource use?
questions.explanation: Resource leveling moves non-critical activities within their float to even out resource demand.

questions.question: The safety standards use the abbreviation 29 CFR Part 1926. What does CFR stand for?
questions.explanation: CFR is the Code of Federal Regulations, and Part 1926 covers construction.

questions.question: OSHA requires fall protection for a difference in elevation greater than how many vertical feet?
questions.explanation: In construction, fall protection is required at 6 feet or more.

questions.question: What is the height of the top guardrail above the floor to protect against falls at a leading edge?
questions.explanation: The top rail sits at 42 inches, give or take 3 inches.

questions.question: Which payment term is the most favorable to the purchaser?
questions.explanation: 3/20 Net 60 gives the biggest early-pay discount (3 percent) and the longest time to pay (60 days), which most benefits the buyer.
